title: Division 9 (Flooring) — VA Building 28 (AF101) Ranked Standard
description: The first WEIGHTED, estimator-validated ranked standard for the Division 9 / flooring vertical. One area-takeoff task on the real VA St. Cloud Building 28 First-Floor Finish Plan (sheet AF101) — a federal, publishable planset that also ships in the public OpenTakeoff demo. Answer keys are WITHHELD: the estimator-validated ground truth lives in the gitignored ground-truth/ directory (never committed; see PROTOCOL §5) and is materialized out-of-tree at scoring time via OTA_GROUNDTRUTH_DIR. This is the canonical REFERENCE standard the board anchors against; blind held-out certification uses the fresh private plansets in the div9-ranked pool.

groundTruth.note: Estimator-validated (Michael Edlin, Head of Estimating, SFG — 2026-07-19). Established in OpenTakeoff on sheet AF101; keys live privately in ground-truth/ and are never distributed.
